summary: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. (formerly Eyenovia) filed an 8-K disclosing voluntary full repayment on September 28, 2026 of its Loan and Security Agreement with Avenue Capital Management II, L.P. as collateral agent and Avenue Venture Opportunities Fund lenders, an up-to-$15.0 million term-loan facility dated November 22, 2022. The approximately $8.6 million payoff, with no early termination penalties, released all liens, security interests and commitments. Funding came from HYPE token sales and cash on hand; the company reported roughly $14.5 million in cash, equivalents and USDC as of September 30, 2026. No deal terms.
